tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Backend Developer | REST APIs & Third-Party Integrations (ERP, PIM) | Clean Code & Docker
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce platform experience for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Proven track record integrating third-party systems including ERP and PIM platforms via RESTful APIs and data pipelines. Hands-on with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD deployment cycles, and automated unit testing with JUnit. Strong foundation in software architecture, design patterns, and clean code, collaborating across agile Scrum teams, architectural discussions, and international business stakeholders.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Software Developer PHP (m/w/d) – E-Commerce & Spryker
cover_en.hook: Detlev Louis has set the benchmark for motorcycle apparel and technical gear e-commerce, where high performance, reliability, and modern platform architecture are vital. With over 5 years of enterprise e-commerce platform engineering at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in scaling modular digital commerce architectures and complex backend integrations.

bullets.label: Third-Party & Core Integrations (ERP, PIM)
bullets.text: Architected and optimized data pipelines connecting enterprise e-commerce platforms with SAP ERP and PIM systems (Profisee), designing robust RESTful APIs to ensure consistent catalog synchronization across channels.

bullets.label: CI/CD & Automated Testing
bullets.text: Executed deployment cycles within agile DevOps pipelines and built automated test suites with JUnit, safeguarding high release quality and clean code standards.

bullets.label: Architecture & Containerization
bullets.text: Experienced with Docker, Kubernetes, and enterprise design patterns; actively contribute to code reviews, API migrations, and architectural alignment across cross-functional engineering teams.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & Scrum
bullets.text: Thrive in collaborative Scrum environments using Jira and Confluence, bridging business requirements and technical implementation while mentoring junior developers.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit (no sponsorship required), I am currently serving my notice period with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my backend and integration experience can contribute to Detlev Louis's e-commerce platform.

tailoring.why_company: Detlev Louis combines authentic passion for motorcycling with serious digital commerce excellence. I admire your commitment to evolving the shop architecture, fostering engineering growth from developer to lead developer, and maintaining high software quality through automated testing and collaborative architecture rounds.
tailoring.motivation_short: With 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions, RESTful integrations, and containerized services, I want to bring my architectural rigor and passion for scalable online shops to the agile engineering team at Detlev Louis.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I noticed Detlev Louis is expanding its e-commerce engineering team. With 5+ years engineering high-scale e-commerce platforms, third-party ERP/PIM integrations, REST APIs, and Docker/K8s, I would love to connect regarding your current developer openings.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Software Developer – E-Commerce / Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Software Developer e-commerce position at Detlev Louis.

With over 5 years of enterprise e-commerce experience delivering third-party ERP and PIM integrations, RESTful APIs, and containerized workflows in agile Scrum setups, I look forward to contributing to your platform's reliability and architectural growth.

I am currently serving my notice period and available to start on 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
